items.title: Mike Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2024
items.q: phenomenal younger players like Marshall and Mike Dease and Ryan Keberle who are just taking the instrument and running with it

ctx.x: Do you mind saying it for me?

Well yeah, he said, “In this bone dry era it’s essential to have Michael Davis around.” It’s not so applicable anymore ‘cause there’s so many great trombone players now that, I mean it’s never been healthier for the trombone in terms of the players that are playing now from Marshall Gilkes to Michael Dease to Ryan Keberle to just endless number — it feels like it’s endless. But back when I was starting and starting to do my own records, not as much. You know there weren’t as many trombone players around doing…

Okay I’m going to try a little something on you here. I have a list of some of the people that you’ve recorded for or perhaps done a tour with. And I’m going to start reading it and I want you to stop me if there’s something of significance that you’d like to say about it. All right?
